visual_logic.color_palette: Muddy brown-green with 'Glauconitic' green highlights along the spine, running seamlessly from head to tail across its long horizontal profile.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Jagged, vertical 'river-reed' stripes in dark tan across its side flank to help it camouflage in the silty Conway waters.
visual_logic.eyes: Bright copper eyes with high reflectivity, facing laterally in the profile view.
visual_logic.environment: Murky, 'Silt Grey' water with visible organic debris. Large, rounded calcareous concretions sit on the sea floor in the lower background layer to keep the reptile's profile clean and un-obscured.

pose: A strict side-profile view displaying the full horizontal length of the marine reptile swimming from left to right. To accommodate the length tracking format of the UI measuring tape, the serpentine S-curve is smoothed into a level, elongated horizontal swimming pose parallel to the frame edge, cleanly mapping out its streamlined neck, long torso, extended paddle flippers, and powerful sweeping tail fin.
